description.value:
When an attack would strike you from range, you snap up a Force-born ward to turn the blow aside. The triggering attack's damage against you is reduced by 1d10.

If that reduction brings the damage to 0 and the attack dealt energy, force, ion, kinetic, lightning, necrotic, or sonic damage, you may redirect it: as part of the same reaction, make a ranged force attack (normal range 30 feet, long range 90 feet) against a target you can see. On a hit, that target suffers the original attack's damage.

Cast with a 2nd-level slot or higher, the damage reduction improves by an additional 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 1
